intended_object: The grading of the internally shifted vertex projective P_i{d} of the zigzag algebra, with (P_i{d})_p = (P_i)_{p-d}, so that [P_i{1}] = q[P_i]. Inferred from the docstring and the module documentation (Huerfano–Khovanov, Ehrig–Tubbenhauer).
explanation: `Graded.shift 𝒜 c` is defined as `fun p ↦ 𝒜 (p + c)`. With c = -d, the degree-p piece is zigzagProjectiveGrade k G i (p - d), which is exactly (P_i)_{p-d}; the lemma zigzagProjectiveShiftGrade_apply states this. With this convention the graded dimension of P_i{1} is q times that of P_i, as the docstring claims, so the definition matches its docstring and the standard shift convention. It is a specific object built with the library's general shift operation, and it already works over any commutative ring, so it is not too narrow.
